summary: End-to-end testing of new Landing + Flow Payments features (shop.py). Backend: 14/14 pytest cases passed (public landing, free checkout w/ auto-enroll, paid checkout w/ fake Flow keys returns 400 and no orphan pending payment, missing Flow config returns 503, flow/confirm returns 200 on unknown token, flow/return 303 redirects to /pago/resultado?orden=, HMAC-SHA256 signature matches spec, admin landing GET/PUT, admin payment-settings masks secret_key (returns secret_hint='••••xxxx'), payments list, mark-paid enrolls student + marks pagado, send-link errors with fake keys + no orphan). Frontend: Landing renders with hero slider (3 default slides when none configured), landing-slide-next/prev/dot-N testids present, 2 published courses on landing (test-c1 $49.900 and test-c2 Gratis), FAQ accordion visible, mobile 390px renders. Free enrollment dialog -> submit redirects to /pago/resultado?orden=<id> with payment-result-status '¡Inscripción confirmada!'. Paid enrollment with fake Flow keys shows toast 'Flow rechazó la solicitud. Revisa las credenciales en Sitio web y pagos.' and no orphan pending payment is created. Logged-in admin visiting / is redirected to dashboard (not landing). /pagos admin page lists completed payments with stats cards and search; /sitio-web shows Flow env toggles (flow-env-sandbox/production) and website-slide-add button that reveals website-slide-image-0 upload field.

issues: DialogContent missing aria-describedby (accessibility warning in console, non-blocking)

critical_code_review_comments: shop.py imports from server which also imports shop (shop_router) -> circular import; works in prod because server.py imports shop at module bottom but means shop.py cannot be imported standalone before server has initialized. Consider moving admin_only/staff_only/create_user/enroll/app_base into a shared deps module.
flow_return endpoint catches HTTPException silently; consider logging the failure for observability.

public_image query: `used = any(...) or await db.courses.find_one(...)` - if the `any(...)` is truthy it skips the DB check (correct), but the ordering means every unused file_id triggers a DB query (acceptable but could be rate-limited for abuse).
In mark-paid, if grant_access succeeds and send_email fails, status is already updated (correct); but if admin re-clicks it is idempotent (grant_access checks pay.enrolled).
Add aria-describedby/DialogDescription to the landing enroll dialog to clear console accessibility warning.
test_credentials: Admin test-admin-1 via JWT: cd /app/backend && python3 -c "from core import create_token;print(create_token('test-admin-1'))" -> localStorage 'otec_token'. Seeded courses: test-c1 (paid 49900), test-c2 (free). Fake Flow keys FAKE-KEY/fakesecret123.
seed_data_creation: Tests create and clean up their own TEST_ users/payments/enrollments. Cleaned up delivered+pwfree@resend.dev and delivered+pwpaid@resend.dev after Playwright run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new landing/payments endpoints verified working. Flow real-key checkout cannot be tested until user supplies real sandbox credentials. If retesting, note that admin landing GET/PUT and website-slide-image-* testids only appear after clicking data-testid='website-slide-add'.
